# coarser than

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/coarserThan>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Orders the granularity axis: relates a granularity level to a finer level it generalizes (country [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) city). Transitive; the partial order that makes 'at or above a target level' well-defined for coarsening, and mirrors [skos:broader](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#broader) between the levels.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to order two granularity levels so a coarsening target ('no finer than city') is well-defined, or to seed a per-domain resolution ladder (spatial, temporal).

### Avoid when

- Avoid for ordering ordinary quantitative values (that is a measurement, not a granularity level) and avoid wiring it between domains' ladders without an explicit cross-domain alignment.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) from the coarser level to the finer one and let transitivity build the ladder; align levels to external resolution vocabularies ([time:TemporalUnit](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#TemporalUnit), ISO 19112 LocationType) with [skos:exactMatch.](http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#exactMatch.)

### Examples

- ex:countryLevel [`gmeow:coarserThan`](gmeow-coarserThan.md) ex:cityLevel.
